methodology: Recovery of preexisting preliminary screening only. Source branch's inspected flags do not satisfy public primary-source verification. No new screening, independent critical-edition collation, manuscript dating, database writes, or public promotion.

records.topic: Prohibition of corruption after restoration; fear and hope in prayer
records.notes: Generic ethical and supplication language; no source-specific earlier parallel established in this first pass.

records.topic: Winds, rain-bearing clouds, revived barren earth as resurrection analogy

candidates.similarity: God waters earth and causes vegetation to grow
candidates.difference: Psalm celebrates provision; Qur'an adds wind/cloud sequence and explicitly uses revivification as resurrection analogy

records.notes: Psalm inspected in translation; exact Hebrew and dating not critically collated.

records.topic: Good soil yields vegetation, poor soil yields sparse growth

candidates.difference: Mark's sower parable is explicitly about reception of the word; Qur'an 7:58 emphasizes divine signs, good land and deficient yield; do not treat as identical

records.topic: Noah sent to his people calling for worship of God alone and warning of judgment

candidates.similarity: Noah is associated with a corrupt society and divine judgment
candidates.difference: Genesis emphasizes Noah's righteousness and ark instructions; Qur'an 7:59 explicitly portrays Noah as a messenger calling his people to exclusive worship

records.notes: Hebrew and English of Genesis 6 reviewed through Sefaria; Qur'anic wording and textual witnesses require formal edition review.

records.topic: Leaders accuse Noah of obvious error
records.notes: Genesis 6:9–22 does not present the leaders' accusation; later Jewish, Christian and Islamic Noah traditions should be checked before treating absence as definitive.
